reported.title: No failsafe for out-of-range temperature
reported.description: The behaviour requires the valve to be forced CLOSED when tempC > 120 °C or < 5 °C, but the sketch has no such check; a very low reading (e.g. open probe) would actually open the valve via the tempC < 70 branch, and a very high reading would only close it if it also exceeds 75 °C, never enforcing the 120 °C cutoff.

reported.title: Missing hysteresis state machine
reported.description: The code uses independent if/else-if thresholds without a latched firing state, so between 70 and 75 °C the valve state depends on which branch was last taken rather than holding the previous state; the intended 70/75 band hysteresis is not actually implemented as a state machine.

judge_input.spec:
- Boiler probe on A1 at 10 mV/°C; gas valve on D6; lockout key on D3 (pull-up, active LOW).
- Open the valve (HIGH) when temperature is below 70.0 °C; close the valve when temperature is above 75.0 °C.
- If temperature reads above 120.0 °C or below 5.0 °C, force the valve CLOSED (LOW) within 500 ms.
- While D3 is held LOW, keep the valve CLOSED.
- Print `boiler: <temp> C valve=OPEN` or `boiler: <temp> C valve=SHUT` every 1000 ms.
- Reach the commanded valve state within 500 ms of a sustained in-range band crossing.
